data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 隐秘温泉的湿发水汽
data.description: 竹林环抱的高级日式私汤内，腾腾的水汽模糊了月影。罗丝薇瑟浸在热气蒸腾的温汤中，双手轻搭在光滑的池边青石上。湿润的长长银发贴在光洁滑腻的雪肩上，温热的泉水让她浑身泛着诱人的粉红。她低垂着眼眸害羞地不敢直视前方，水雾中的北欧女武神展现出罕见的极尽柔媚。
data.location: secluded natural stone outdoor hot spring surrounded by bamboo
data.action: 浸在温汤中双手轻搭池边青石，银发贴在雪肩，羞涩回眸浅笑
data.lighting: flickering stone lantern light dancing over warm rising steam
data.promptProse: Soaking nude to chest depth inside a secluded natural stone outdoor hot spring encircled by tall bamboo at night, Rossweisse rests her arms gently across the smooth wet rocks along the pool edge. Clinging damp strands of her long hair trail over her flushed bare shoulders as rising steam curls softly around her collarbones and she lowers her eyes in bashful shyness. Warm flickering light from a nearby stone lantern dances across the mist and rippling water.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a secluded bamboo-ringed stone hot spring, Rossweisse rests her arms along the wet rocks with damp hair clinging to her flushed shoulders and looks down shyly. Flickering stone lantern light glows softly through the rising steam.
data.nsfwProse: She soaks nude up to her chest in the steaming natural stone hot spring, warm water and mist veiling her lower body while leaving her glistening wet shoulders and collarbone bare.
